description: Puts three stereo signals onto a bus chain, one per bus, adding them to the blue, orange and red buses arriving at BUS IN

params.text: Sets the level of the blue L and R inputs going onto the blue stereo bus, with no effect on what arrives at BUS IN
Sets the level of the orange L and R inputs going onto the orange stereo bus, with no effect on what arrives at BUS IN
Sets the level of the red L and R inputs going onto the red stereo bus, with no effect on what arrives at BUS IN

inputs.text: Added to the left channel of the blue stereo bus at the level set by the blue LEVEL knob
Added to the right channel of the blue stereo bus at the level set by the blue LEVEL knob
Added to the left channel of the orange stereo bus at the level set by the orange LEVEL knob
Added to the right channel of the orange stereo bus at the level set by the orange LEVEL knob
Added to the left channel of the red stereo bus at the level set by the red LEVEL knob
Added to the right channel of the red stereo bus at the level set by the red LEVEL knob
Takes the three stereo buses from another module's BUS OUT; what arrives here reaches BUS OUT unchanged by the level knobs

outputs.text: Carries the three stereo buses as six channels on one polyphonic cable, blue then orange then red, left before right, each the sum of what arrived at BUS IN and its own pair of input jacks

notes: the three level knobs work on the six input jacks only; with nothing patched into BUS IN this module starts a bus chain, and that chain has to reach a Bus Depot before any of it is heard
